proposal.summary: Authenticated user can trigger a denial of service in GitLab when importing or cloning malicious content in affected versions.
proposal.affected_product: GitLab all versions starting from 15.11 before 16.1.5; all versions starting from 16.2 before 16.2.5; all versions starting from 16.3 before 16.3.1
